sentences.text:
S.B. Criminal Miscellaneous Bail Application No. 3458/2023 Raju Jat S/o Vishram Jat, Aged About 27 Years, R/o Ravo Ka Mohalla, Village Didwada, Police Station Bandarsindhari, District Ajmer (Raj.) ( At Present In Central Jail Ajmer)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State Of Rajasthan, Through P.p.
 ----Respondent For Petitioner(s) : Mr. Anil Kumar For Respondent(s) : Mr. M.K. Sheoran, PP
Mr. Hanish Khan  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE PRAVEER BHATNAGAR  Order 18/12/2023
The instant bail application has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. on behalf of accused-petitioner.

The petitioner has been arrested in connection with FIR No.206/2022 registered at Police Station Bandarsindhari, District Ajmer for the offence(s) under Sections 307, 323, 452, 354, 384 and 394 of I.P.C.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner has falsely been implicated under Sections 307, 323, 452, 354, 384 and 394 & 376/511 of I.P.C.

He further submits that the injuries Raju Jat S/O Vishram Jat vs State Of Rajasthan (2023:Rj-Jp:40168) on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55963144/
1 caused to the prosecutrix were found to be simple in nature and not dangerous to life.

sentences.text: The present petitioner has been impleaded as he demanded his ornaments from the prosecutrix and the FIR is delayed by one day.

The trial of the case may take [2023:RJ-JP:40168] (2 of 3)
[CRLMB-3458/2023] considerable time, therefore, the bail application of the accused- petitioner may be allowed.
Learned Public Prosecutor and learned counsel appearing on behalf of complainant/prosecutrix vehemently oppose the grant of bail application.

Learned counsel appearing on behalf of complainant/prosecutrix submits that the investigation reveals that the accused-petitioner assaulted the prosecutrix after entering into her house and tried to commit rape and after scuffle between prosecutrix and the petitioner, the petitioner with the aid of knife caused five injuries at her body.
He further submits that due to the injury at neck, the prosecutrix received fourteen stitches.

The police after investigation has charge-sheeted the accused-petitioner under Sections 307, 323, 354,
384, 452 and 376 read with 511 of I.P.C., thus, looking to the gravity of the offence and injuries caused to the prosecutrix the bail application of the petitioner may be dismissed.

I have heard learned counsel for the parties and considered the fact that the charge-sheet has already been submitted against the present petitioner under Sections 307, 323, 354, 384, 452 and 376 read with 511 of I.P.C.

The prosecutrix in her statement recorded under Section 161 of Cr.P.C.
has specifically stated that present petitioner forcibly entered into her house and tried to commit rape and afterwards caused injuries at her neck & hands with the aid of knife.

Though, the concerned Medical Jurist has opined that injury at neck was not dangerous to life but looking to the nature of allegations and injury at vital part with the sharp edged weapon, I am not inclined to enlarge the present petitioner on bail.
[2023:RJ-JP:40168] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-3458/2023] Hence, the bail application of the accused-petitioner under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is dismissed.

(PRAVEER BHATNAGAR),J 12-SURAJ KUMAR & GAUTAM JAIN Powered by TCPDF (www.tcpdf.org)
